from datetime import datetime

storage_account = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
silver_path = f"abfss://workinstruction@{storage_account}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver_xps/"

print(f"🔧 Weekly Maintenance — {datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}")
print("=" * 60)

# Check file count before
before = spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE DETAIL delta.`{silver_path}`").collect()[0]["numFiles"]

# Optimize entire table (all partitions)
spark.sql(f"OPTIMIZE delta.`{silver_path}`")

# Check file count after
after = spark.sql(f"DESCRIBE DETAIL delta.`{silver_path}`").collect()[0]["numFiles"]

print(f"  ✅ silver_xps (all partitions): {before} files → {after} files")

print("=" * 60)
print("✅ Weekly maintenance complete!")
